security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; script-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'none'; frame-src 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Resupply planning by truck, drone and airdrop
bundle.longDescription: Plans deliveries by truck, drone and parachute airdrop on real terrain, OpenStreetMap roads, weather forecasts and Sentinel-2 imagery, with line-of-sight risk, wind-aware drone range, Monte Carlo airdrop accuracy and satellite flood detection.
